name: astrozangli-ai
description: AstroZangli AI - 天文历法AI应用

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONWARNINGS=ignore::DeprecationWarning venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.install:all: npm install && python3 -m venv backend/venv && backend/venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

author: AstroZangli Team
